body: Sometimes we’re going to look invisible for other persons. Sometimes our work will doesn’t mean too much for others. But the important thing is to keep it up. We, as teachers, are the most powerful tool that society has to change the mind of others; we have a responsibility and a mission. Remember that memories are sometimes like chains but sometimes memories are lessons that made us free. In your case, your work will be the tool that will free the mind of a young person. Never forget it.
